newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: FIVE KILLED, THREE HURT AT ZAMBIAN OXYGEN PLANT.
newsitem.headline: FIVE KILLED, THREE HURT AT ZAMBIAN OXYGEN PLANT.

text.p: Five people were killed and three others injured in a tanker explosion at the state-run Zambia Oxygen plant in the capital Lusaka on Tuesday, police said.
Police spokesman Francis Musonda said the explosion was caused by a technical error in the decanting of liquified petroleum gas at the Zamox plant just before midday (1000 GMT) on Tuesday.
"Five people, all of them Zamox employees, died instantly in the explosion. Three were injured, two of them quite seriously," Musonda told Reuters.
Police would investigate a possible charge of criminal negligence, he said.
